description: Marko Kaasik at the University of Tartu publishes observations from the Valgjärve mast in Estonia for 2015–2018. The Zenodo deposit identifies FMP Network Tartu01 and provides a RAR archive free under CC BY 4.0. Institutional proceedings describe the mast as a source of multi-height wind observations for wind-resource assessment and atmospheric-model checks. The collection can therefore supply local calibration evidence for wind-energy and weather simulations. The companion data-valgjarve-wind-mast-observations-2018-2021 covers the later period; neither is explicitly included by a current catalogue record. Coverage is one measurement installation, not a national wind map. The archive-specific variables, units, height completeness and sampling interval remain unknown from the landing page. Instrument capabilities described in the proceedings do not prove that every channel is included. The two archives may overlap in 2018, so users must check timestamps before combining them. No observations were downloaded or continuity and quality-control flags checked.
